title: cPanel, WHM Release Fixes for Three New Vulnerabilities — Patch Now
summary: cPanel has released updates to address three vulnerabilities in cPanel and Web Host Manager (WHM) that could be exploited to achieve privilege escalation, code execution, and denial-of-service.
